entries.title: Psalms 51:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David; when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bath-sheba.>> Be gracious unto me, O God, according to thy loving-kindness; according to the abundance of thy tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

entries.title: Psalms 51:2
segments: Wash me fully from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

entries.title: Psalms 51:3
segments: For I acknowledge my transgressions, and my sin is continually before me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:4
segments: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done what is evil in thy sight; that thou mayest be justified when thou speakest, be clear when thou judgest.

entries.title: Psalms 51:5
segments: Behold, in iniquity was I brought forth, and in sin did my mother conceive me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:6
segments: Behold, thou wilt have truth in the inward parts; and in the hidden [part] thou wilt make me to know wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 51:7
segments: ¶Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean; wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

entries.title: Psalms 51:8
segments: Make me to hear gladness and joy; [that] the bones which thou hast broken may rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 51:9
segments: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

entries.title: Psalms 51:10
segments: Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:11
segments: Cast me not away from thy presence, and take not the spirit of thy holiness from me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:12
segments: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, and let a willing spirit sustain me.

entries.title: Psalms 51:13
segments: I will teach transgressors thy ways, and sinners shall return unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 51:14
segments: ¶Deliver me from blood-guiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 51:15
segments: Lord, open my lips, and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:16
segments: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou hast no pleasure in burnt-offering.

entries.title: Psalms 51:17
segments: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

entries.title: Psalms 51:18
segments: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion; build the walls of Jerusalem.

entries.title: Psalms 51:19
segments: Then shalt thou have sacrifices of righteousness, burnt-offering, and whole burnt-offering; then shall they offer up bullocks upon thine altar.
